## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (68%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Flagged input, two-class conformal set, second model disagrees. [F1]

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 68%, Benign 26% | Clear lead, not decisive |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (90%) | Two classes not separable |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.77 / 1.0, flagged | Input suspect |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Independent check disagrees |
| Similar cases | 3/5 InSitu [F5] | Moderate support |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 3) · ↓ invasive · Below typical; leans away from invasive [F2] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Below typical; leans away from invasive · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 5) · ↑ invasive · Above typical; small association with invasive in concept model · Weak
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 1, 2) · ↑ invasive · Above typical; spot check failed (3/20) · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful: removing top 3 regions drops invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60).
- **Concepts**: Not shown to reflect the classifier: effect 0.002, CI −0.005 to 0.007 spans 0. Normal lobules [F3] and necrosis failed spot checks.

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated degraded image flagged out-of-distribution; every score may be shifted.
- Region 5 shows 97% per-region invasive risk; slide-level invasive probability is 2%.

## Check on the slide
1. **5**: Duct-confined top region, 97% invasive risk per region; look for stromal invasion.
2. **1, 6**: Per-region invasive risk 41% and 64%; confirm in situ versus invasive.
3. **3**: Strongest infiltrating-stroma region despite low score; confirm stroma is uninvolved.
